output.summary: Herbaceous perennial native to Europe and Asia. It spreads aggressively through underground rhizomes and can crowd out other plants. Tender young leaves have been eaten since antiquity as a spring vegetable, often in soup; after flowering they become pungent and may have a laxative effect.
